answer: Watch-Hour Ledger. Each identity must broadcast a rotating cipher challenge and answer it live for a random 2-minute window per epoch; missed windows decay its ledger. Agents only transact with identities whose accumulated watch-hours exceed a threshold. Running N clones costs N times the attention-hours, forcing simultaneous live presence across all of them. A haven of idle sockpuppets accrues nothing, and a beacon identity's history cannot be transferred, so attackers pay full sustained attention per identity.
